children: Hashi mainnet is scheduled to begin rolling out in October 2026 with more than $500 million in committed capital. Fluid provides the lending layer for Bitcoin-backed loans, while Anchorage Digital joins as a launch partner to provide qualified custody and stablecoin liquidity.

Bitcoin-backed borrowing on Hashi connects the mainnet rollout directly to adoption of Fluid's lending layer. Loan activity creates a route to fee growth for Fluid through this integration. However, the capital committed to the rollout is not an established measure of deposits in Fluid markets. Realized total value locked in those markets remains unconfirmed by the announcement.
Just in from the main stage at Sui Basecamp:
👉 Hashi mainnet starts rolling out this month, with $500M+ in capital already committed.

title: Fluid: powers Bitcoin-backed lending as Hashi mainnet begins rollout - Oct 2026
